status: Exploratory extension fixed before lineage score outcomes
selection: Deposited primary tumour cells only (Lymph node=0); author-defined malignant/nonmalignant annotations; unknown cells excluded; patient ID from HN/HNSCC numeric prefix
mapping: Myeloid pools macrophage, dendritic and mast; stromal pools fibroblast, endothelial, myocyte; strip leading hyphen in Fibroblast label
processing: Invert deposited log2(TPM/10+1); mean TPM per patient-lineage; transform log1p for ssGSEA. This is a TPM-derived aggregate, not raw-count pseudobulk and not true tissue RNA abundance
analysis: Descriptive patient-lineage profiles, patient-centered score heatmap; fixed five-lineage mixture only if at least eight patients have >=10 cells in all five; otherwise report feasibility failure without relaxing threshold
limitation: Captured cell fractions are affected by dissociation and sampling and are not tissue histological fractions; no functional-state or TLS truth supplied
patient_identity_exclusion: 109 combo-labelled cells without a numeric patient prefix excluded before expression scoring; no inferred patient assignment
